relationships.description: The chart series reads the plotted values directly from the persistent collection (table, measurement or index) that holds the records behind its value and category fields.
relationships.evidence: The series' value-field or data source configuration names the physical collection, e.g. a dashboard query or series definition referencing the time-series measurement or table by name.

relationships.description: The chart series takes its value and category fields from the data-binding declaration that selects the field path within the chart's bound data source.
relationships.evidence: The series spec declares a dataConfig or binding reference, such as a field path like 'data.revenue', that resolves to the DataConfig attached to the parent chart.

relationships.description: The chart series plots the elements of an array-typed data shape, so each item described by the array schema becomes one data point of the series.
relationships.evidence: The series' bound field path points to a JSON Schema property of type 'array' whose item schema defines the value and category fields named in the series configuration.

relationships.description: The chart series names the reusable chart component type, or a mark-rendering library component, whose property schema defines the series options it configures.
relationships.evidence: The series definition carries a component type identifier, such as 'LineChart' or 'BarSeries', that matches a registered LibraryComponent whose props schema accepts series entries.

relationships.description: The chart series changes its visibility, styling or data while a given experience state is active, for example hiding itself in the loading state or highlighting in the editing state.
relationships.evidence: The experience state machine's component rules list the series as enabled, disabled or hidden for that state, or the series' visibility condition references the state name.

notes: accesses data-store.collection bypasses the layering: the DataConfig description says endpoints and entities belong to other layers, so a direct UX-to-collection access duplicates the binds-to path and should be derived through it. maps-to arrayschema overlaps with the binding's field path. uses experiencestate reads inverted, because states govern components rather than series using states.
